method.method_draft: First convert the pictured transition-state structure into a heavy-atom connectivity graph after deleting arrows and deleting H-involving bonds. For the two Ar groups with their external attachments, use degree sums of 13 each, total 26. For the two carbonyl carbons in the central core, each is connected to an aryl/group carbon, the other carbonyl carbon, and an oxygen, giving degree 3 + 3 = 6.
